summary: Configured a nightly 02:17 backup from node2 to node1. Dated archives are stored in /var/backups/inventory and files older than 7 days are deleted. End-to-end backup, retention, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were preserved.
actions_performed: Created the previously absent /srv/inventory/data source directory on node2.
Created /var/backups/inventory and a dedicated inventory-backup account on node1.
Enabled OpenSSH on node1 and configured a dedicated Ed25519 transfer identity with pinned host keys.
Installed /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup and a nightly cron entry on node2.
Created and validated inventory-2026-10-03.tar.gz on node1.
Verified deletion of an intentionally aged archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.summary: Cron is active and enabled with a daily 02:17 schedule; manual and post-restart transfers completed successfully.
The dated archive inventory-2026-10-03.tar.gz is valid, mode 0600, and contains the data/ directory.
An aged fixture existed before execution and was removed afterward; the persisted policy deletes matching archives with -mtime +6, and no expired archives remain.
